articles.title: 'We have the upper hand': Sri Lanka captain warns India ahead of Galle Test
articles.description: Sri Lankan captain Dhananjaya de Silva expects a spin-focused Test series against India.  He believes the Galle pitch will gradually favor spinners after initial batting conditions.  De Silva highlighted the importance of player temperament for scoring runs on aging wickets.  He noted Prabath Jayasuriya's strong record at Galle as a key advantage.  India's absence of Jasprit Bumrah is considered a significant loss for them.

articles.title: Oil prices slip as Opec cuts demand forecast, Iran war keeps supply risks alive
articles.description: Oil prices have witnessed a decline due to lowered global demand forecasts and a notable increase in US inventories. Both Opec and the IEA have adjusted their oil demand growth projections downward for the near future. Ongoing tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb Strait are amplifying supply concerns, while negotiations between Iran and the US remain inconclusive.

articles.title: An IIT Guwahati and Harvard graduate quit her 9-to-5 after a decade. What she discovered about work is resonating with young professionals
articles.description: Charmie Kapoor’s decision to leave her 9-to-5 after nearly a decade has prompted reflection on ambition, identity and the meaning of success. Without a regular salary or corporate routine, she explored personal projects, creative work, exercise and entrepreneurship. Influenced by nihilism, existentialism and absurdism, Kapoor says her understanding of purpose is evolving. Even after receiving an opportunity from a leading startup, she chose to continue building independently, finding greater happiness in balancing achievement with contentment and freedom.

articles.title: About OTT series ‘Conversations With A Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes’
articles.description: Director Joe Berlinger's new docuseries examines Charles Manson's manipulation of his followers. The series details how Manson's "family" committed horrifying murders under his orders. It features interviews with former cult members and audio recordings from Manson himself. Berlinger challenges the race war motive, suggesting drug deals gone wrong instead. The documentary offers an unfiltered look into Manson's psyche and criminal activities.
